result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a very narrow, paved walkway immediately adjacent to the roadway with no buffer or separation. Dense vegetation and a lack of street lighting significantly limit visibility and safety for anyone walking along this corridor.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The paved walking area is extremely narrow, forcing pedestrians to walk in close proximity to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left and center, along the edge of the road

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation along the curve of the road limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Background and right side of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, making the area hazardous for pedestrians after dark.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire scene

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing walkway to standard widths and provide a physical buffer or planting strip to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back trees and bushes to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians along the roadway curve.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, lacking any dedicated sidewalk and forcing pedestrians onto a narrow, overgrown shoulder. Sightlines are severely restricted by dense vegetation on a curve, and existing pavement markings, including a distant crosswalk, are significantly faded.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: No dedicated space for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the road shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the curve prevents visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road along the curve

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: Crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility and compliance.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the middle ground

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk separated from the roadway.

interventions.title: Vegetation Clearing
interventions.description: Trim and maintain roadside vegetation to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental style crosswalks.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with basic crosswalk markings but lacks visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands. The significant crossing distance and high-speed design characteristics create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible to indicate safe crossing intervals at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder style markings to improve visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a wide multi-lane arterial road with no sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to navigate unpaved shoulders in a high-speed traffic environment with no physical separation or safety infrastructure.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians onto the dirt shoulder or into traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The road has four or more travel lanes plus a median, requiring a long unprotected crossing for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: High Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds in an area with no pedestrian separation.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted median into a raised refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
